title: Refinery units, quality and named report schema: code qualification
scope: Synthetic and historical public-data qualification only; no plant model or operating-data approval

model_inputs.representation: Legacy numeric fields use the declared canonical unit; refinery::set_input takes a Quantity, converts compatible units, and rejects dimension mismatches for every numeric planning field.
model_inputs.limitation: The retained public double fields cannot encode the caller's source unit; external values must enter through typed setters for dimension rejection. Raw doubles are interpreted in their declared canonical units.

conversions.sulfur: 1 wt% = 10000 ppm on a mass basis; mg/L divided by density in kg/L gives mg/kg (ppm)
conversions.density_basis: API gravity at 60 F -> approximate t/m3 using 141.5/(API+131.5) and 1 t/m3 reference-water density; no thermal correction. Volume-to-mass and USD/bbl-to-USD/t need a declared positive density
conversions.quality: RON and cetane are separate dimensions; RVP psi converts to kPa
conversions.price: USD/bbl converts to USD/m3; USD/t conversion requires stream density
mismatch_rejection: typed FCC feed mass to volume flow

model_schema.variables: All synthetic LP variables and active bounds are kbpd; objective coefficients and reduced costs are USD/bbl; objective is kUSD/d.
model_schema.rows: Capacity and balance rows are kbpd; gasoline octane deviation is kbpd.RON; fuel-oil sulfur excess is t/d. Each report row labels activity, slacks, coefficient and dual units.
model_schema.sulfur_pool: Fuel-oil residue blend only, using crude API density and sulfur wt% converted to mass fraction under a common residue-draw assumption; conditional named upper-bound row SPEC_FO_MAX_SULFUR_PPM.
model_schema.unmodelled_specs: Cetane, RVP, non-gasoline RON and non-fuel-oil sulfur requests are rejected rather than silently ignored (IR-14).
model_schema.feed_balance: FCC output is converted to gas-oil feed with the FCC capacity-row factor and compared to available gas oil through bbl/d, then reported in kbpd (IR-13 extension).

quality_margins.margin: number, slack to limit in the spec unit

report_json_schema.iis_scope_note: string; variable bounds are held fixed and bound-minimal IIS is unsupported

checks.generator_regeneration: All five owned refinery-related generators produced byte-identical output on repeat calls with fixed seeds or input data and emitted unit declarations.

ownership_note: Generated examples/refinery/fawley-public.mps and data/cases fixtures are outside this run's edit ownership. They require regeneration by their owner to carry the revised generator comments and public-input digest.
